# We found that in this simulation, the cor- responding scores generated by the ﬁrst and second wSIR’s

## Claim
We found that in this simulation, the cor- responding scores generated by the ﬁrst and second wSIR’s directions were highly correlated with the angle and radius, respectively, where, in contrast, GraphPCA and PLS were only able to partially recover the spatial pattern.

## Biological Context
Weighted sliced inverse regression for scalable supervised dimensionality reduction of spatial transcriptomics data
